Find $E(Y)$.

questions.question_text:
A shop's daily takings $T$, in dollars, have $E(T)=800$.
After a $10\%$ commission and a fixed $\$50$ charge, the shop keeps $Y=0.9T-50$.
Find $E(Y)$.

options.why: Subtracted the $\$50$ charge before applying the commission, evaluating $0.9(800-50)$.
Applied the commission but left out the fixed $\$50$ charge.
Subtracted the fixed $\$50$ charge but left out the commission.

Find $E(2X-4)$.
